_about: 2025 年是否出现 X 级太阳耀斑的冻结证据包。信息截至 2025-01-01；使用 NASA/NOAA 在截点前发布的太阳活动周期资料。

evidence.title: NASA, NOAA: Sun Reaches Maximum Phase in 11-Year Solar Cycle
evidence.excerpt: The Sun has reached its solar maximum period, which could continue for the next year.
evidence.claim: 截至 2025 年初，NASA/NOAA 判断太阳处于活动极大期并可能持续一年，为 2025 年出现强耀斑提供较强事前依据。

evidence.title: NOAA forecasts quicker, stronger peak of solar activity
evidence.excerpt: Solar activity will increase more quickly and peak at a higher level than that predicted by an expert panel in December 2019.
evidence.claim: NOAA 在更早的周期预测中已上调 Solar Cycle 25 的峰值强度预期，为后续强耀斑事件提供独立的事前周期信号。
